title: Really cheap fleece, not soft at all.
text:
Really cheap fleece, not soft at all.. This would catch the eye of any Doctor Who fan. That's why we ordered one... love the moon being so prominate in the design.

BUT... know up front that this is not a cozy, soft fleece throw. It is a slightly rough, CHEAP fleece fabric that has been zig-zag stitched around the edges. Cheap, cheap, cheap.
The $4 fleece throws you find every winter in a country-wide discount chain are softer and nicer. Truly sad. The only saving grace is the design. Not a cuddly throw for sure.

This would be much better to hang on a wall as decoration than to use as a throw. :-(
